description: Summarize the Terragrunt run's plan output with an AI model.

env.name: PIPELINES_HOOK_AI_SUMMARY_API_KEY

flags.help: For example: 'claude-sonnet-5' on anthropic, 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5' on openrouter.
